newsitem.title: USA: PECO delays Peach Bottom nuke restart to Wed.
newsitem.headline: PECO delays Peach Bottom nuke restart to Wed.

text.p: PECO Energy Co has postponed the restart of its 1,100 megawatt Peach Bottom nuclear power unit 3 to Wednesday from a shutdown which began over the weekend, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
"We have pushed back the restart to tomorrow," spokesman Michael Wood said, adding "We have some other things we want to finish so that hopefully the unit will not have to shut down again this year."
The company had orginally said it would restart the unit late Monday.
Peach Bottom 3, located in Delta, Pa., tripped off line Sunday while the unit was operating at reduced power for control rod adjustments.
The Peach Bottom nuclear unit 2, also located in Delta, Pa., and with a capacity of 1,100 megawatts, was operating normally at full power as of early Tuesday.
